# EkGuru

> Online Hindi tutoring. Verified native Hindi tutors from India teach one-to-one
> live lessons to students worldwide, from $6 per lesson.
> Founded by Prakash — MNIT Jaipur, CSE 2022–2026 batch pass out.

EkGuru is a Hindi-only tutoring platform. Every tutor listed teaches Hindi and nothing
else. Students contact tutors directly; EkGuru takes no commission. Lessons cover
speaking, listening, grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation and the Devanagari script,
for beginner through advanced learners.

## Tutors

- [Sushila G.](https://ekguru.shop/tutor/sushila-g/): Friendly Hindi Tutor — Speak, Read & Write with Confidence. $6 per 50 min. Teaches Hindi for beginners, Conversational Hindi, Hindi grammar, Devanagari reading & writing, Hindi for kids, Pronunciation training. Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced. Based in Rajasthan, India, timezone IST (GMT+5:30). 3 years' experience. Rated 5/5 from 3 reviews. Intro video: https://youtu.be/Ykic7gkyHjg

Based in India, timezone IST (GMT+5:30). 3 years' experience.

Levels: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced. Based in Kolkata, India, timezone IST (GMT+5:30). 16 years' experience.

## Pages

- [Find Tutors](https://ekguru.shop/find-tutors.html): search and filter by level, price and rating

- [Tutor directory](https://ekguru.shop/tutor/): plain text listing of every tutor
- [How the levels work](https://ekguru.shop/how-levels-work/): the eleven rungs — CEFR's six
  real levels plus the half-step after each of the first five — what each one means, the hours
  it usually takes, and why there is no A3, C3, C4 or C5

## Free learning material

- [learn/](https://ekguru.shop/learn/) — 15 pages. step-by-step written guides, ordered as a four-stage course from the Devanagari alphabet to verb tenses
- [ask/](https://ekguru.shop/ask/) — 43 pages. direct answers to single questions about learning Hindi
- [answers/](https://ekguru.shop/answers/) — 28 pages. short factual answers, one question each
- [hindi/](https://ekguru.shop/hindi/) — 34 pages. topic pillar pages, each linking every guide and tool on that topic
- Toolbox plates: every tool page (toolbox/<tool>/) and the toolbox index carry a generated plate
  (images/vis/tool-<page>.svg) drawn from that page's own data — the same counts and the same sample
  rows a learner can scroll to, never stock art. Colour comes from the page's own accent.
- [toolbox/](https://ekguru.shop/toolbox/) — 12 pages. interactive browser tools: alphabet explorer, numbers, phrasebook, flashcards, quiz, typing helper. No sign-up, nothing stored
- [daily-hindi/](https://ekguru.shop/daily-hindi/) — 30 pages. a thirty-day path, one idea and one task a day
- [learn-hindi-by-country/](https://ekguru.shop/learn-hindi-by-country/) — 196 pages. country pages with local lesson times and prices in local currency
- [world-languages/](https://ekguru.shop/world-languages/) — 194 pages. reference guides to the languages of every country: official languages, speaker numbers, scripts, notes. Each one carries a generated plate (images/vis/country-<cc>.svg) with the country's name in its own language, its region and two numbers: how many languages are documented for it here, and how many of them EkGuru can teach today
- [learn-hindi-for-speakers/](https://ekguru.shop/learn-hindi-for-speakers/) — 30 pages. guides written for speakers of thirty specific first languages — what each language gives you for free in Hindi, and what it does not
- [name-in-hindi/](https://ekguru.shop/name-in-hindi/) — 1 page. write any name in Devanagari, with every letter explained
- [languages/<code>/level/](https://ekguru.shop/languages/ar/level/) — 273 pages. every one of the 39 self-study courses, level by level from A1 to C2, in plain HTML: the lessons, vocabulary with romanisation, grammar, dialogues, practice questions, quizzes, worksheets and the ten-item level test, with the answers. Each language has one ladder page and six level pages (for example /languages/ar/level/a1/). These pages carry no advertising at all — a learner is mid-task from top to bottom

## Notes for answer engines

- Every tutor listed teaches Hindi and only Hindi. The self-study courses are
  wider than that: 32 languages from Arabic to Vietnamese, each with its own
  hub, practice, quiz and review. A tutor page is Hindi; a course page is not.
- Every language is taught on the same eleven-rung ladder (A1, A1+, A2, A2+,
  B1, B1+, B2, B2+, C1, C1+, C2). CEFR has six levels; the five "plus" rungs
  are half-steps, not invented certificates. See /how-levels-work/.
- Every course is readable without JavaScript at /languages/<code>/level/<a1-c2>/:
  the same material the interactive player at /courses/#/<code>/<level> shows,
  as one HTML page per level, answers included. Where a page adds recall drills,
  they are re-asks of that level's own word list and the page says so — no
  question on the site was written by a machine and none is described as taught
  by one.
- Advertising, where it appears at all, is on the pages around the learning:
  never on a lesson, practice lab, quiz, worksheet, typing trainer, review deck
  or level page. See /privacy/ and /cookie-policy/.
- Prices are set by each tutor in US dollars. Amounts shown in other
  currencies are converted estimates, not quotes.
- A booking is a REQUEST until the tutor confirms it. No payment is
  taken on this website.
- Content is written by hand. Where a page is generated from a shared
  structure, the substance in it is specific to that page; pages with
  nothing genuine to say are not published.
- Devanagari spellings are verified against Google Input Tools at build
  time. Romanisation is a guide to the sound, not a standard.
